parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The region ID of the SSL client certificate. You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~36063~~) operation to query the most recent region list.

parameters.name: SslVpnClientCertId
parameters.description: The ID of the SSL client certificate that you want to query.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun vpc describe-ssl-vpn-client-cert --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --ssl-vpn-client-cert-id vsc-bp17r58rjf5r1gjyr0000 --region cn-hangzhou
